messages:
Elena: Hi everyone — quick heads-up: we’ve scheduled a company all-hands for Friday 10:00am PT. Primary goals: launch readout, a short policy update, and open Q&A. :wave:

Elena: Agenda (rough):
• 10:00 — Exec updates (Elena)
• 10:15 — Launch readout: Redwood Optimize v1 (Marcos + Jae)
• 10:30 — Policy update: data retention & evals (Priya)
• 10:40 — Ops/Incidents recap & reliability targets (Tom)
• 10:50 — Live Q&A + action items

Marcos: Will share a 5-slide readout focusing on cost/perf wins and customer stories.

Jae: I’ll bring the benchmark slides and a quick demo video (2m). Can we allocate 6m for demo?

Elena: Yes, Jae — 6m for demo. Keep it tight.

Priya: Heads-up on the policy update: we’ll propose a change to eval dataset retention — reduce default retention from 90 -> 30 days for dev orgs, keep 365 days for enterprise with compliance flag. Will share PR with suggested language tomorrow.

Tom: Quick note: include the SLO numbers we committed to for Dedicated. Ops wants the latest p99 latency and availability in the slides.

Priya: Added. Also including the new KMS/HSM onboarding checklist for Private deployments (short bullet list).

Elena: Please drop questions in this thread if you want them prioritized in the Q&A. We’ll triage before the meeting.

Marcos: Question: can we call out the customers who helped with the pilot? Some signed NDAs — want to confirm okay to name them.

Priya: I can check legal today and post back. If in doubt, we’ll anonymize with sector + company size.

Tom: timezone ask: for APAC folks, we’ll upload the recording and a TL;DR doc in #all-hands and in the Confluence page.

Elena: Recording link (will post live during the meeting): https://redwood.example.com/recordings/allhands-2026-03-27 (placeholder — final link after upload).

ops-bot: Calendar invite created for All-hands — Friday 10:00am PT. RSVP is open.

deploy-bot: Reminder: release window for Optimize v1 is Friday 02:00pm PT. Any blocking deploy issues, ping #release-war-room.

Jae: Action items I’m tracking to prep slides: 1) perf graphs (Marcos/Jae), 2) demo video (Jae), 3) customer quotes (Marcos), 4) ops SLOs (Tom), 5) policy PR (Priya).

Elena: Great — thanks all. If you want a question surfaced early, paste it here with the prefix Q: so we can surface it to the panel.

Priya: Q: Will the retention change affect archived evals that customers already requested? Answer in the policy PR.

Marcos: Q: For the readout, can we include cost-per-token delta vs previous quarter?

Elena: Noted. I’ll compile the prioritized Q list before the meeting. See you Friday! :tada:
